dimensions.reasons: The author final render (alpine_gondola_goldenhour_4k) clearly depicts the required alpine valley: snowy mountain ridge, central frozen lake, conifer-covered slopes, diagonal lift cables, support pylons, and red cabins. Its overall valley-and-gondola concept is recognizably based on the reference.
issues: The terrain, trees, cabins, and tower are substantially more stylized and simplified than the photographic target.
The reference's distinctive rugged foreground cliffs, denser natural forest variation, and lattice lift tower are not faithfully reproduced.
Only about three cabins are readily visible in the final compared with roughly five in the reference.

dimensions.reasons: In the final image, the major foreground pylon appears planted in the snow and the cabin hangers visibly connect to the cables; the tower crossarms also provide plausible cable support. However, the evaluator wide views expose the actual terrain as a bounded, thin landform with abrupt vertical sides and a dark underside.
issues: wide_lake_ridge, wide_lift_valley, wide_receding_lift, and wide_valley_front expose large cut edges and black/brown terrain undersides.
The landscape is not physically coherent as continuous mountain ground when seen beyond the final camera framing.
The pylons are very simplified solid poles rather than the more structurally credible lattice support visible in the reference.

dimensions.reasons: The rendered objects retain clear identities: red-and-dark-window gondola cabins, gray pylons, thin dark cables, snowy conifers, icy lake, and snow-and-rock mountains are all visually legible in alpine_gondola_goldenhour_4k. The warm pale-gold sky and saturated red cabins provide a clean illustrative color treatment.
issues: The repeated stacked-disc conifers read as low-poly decorative trees rather than snow-laden natural firs.
Cabins are generic rounded capsules with very limited gondola-frame, window, and hanger detail.
Mountain rock, snow, and tree colors are comparatively uniform and lack the richer natural variation in the reference.

dimensions.reasons: The designated author final is clean, well-resolved, and coherent as a polished stylized geography illustration, with no visible noise or severe rendering artifacts. The distant lake, layered mountains, and clustered forest establish useful depth.
issues: The scene does not achieve the reference photo's naturalistic terrain, irregular tree forms, or detailed lift engineering.
Repeated low-poly tree silhouettes and broad smoothed snow forms make the landscape look synthetic.
The actual scene's slab-like extent visible in Group A undermines realism outside the chosen final framing.

dimensions.reasons: The author final places the lake in the distant center, flanks it with wooded snowy slopes, and runs multiple cables diagonally from upper right toward the left-middle distance, closely following the reference's broad spatial logic. A large foreground-right pylon and receding supports establish the lift route.
issues: The foreground pylon is much more centrally dominant than the reference's visually lighter tower arrangement.
The closest gondola sits lower and closer to the main tower rather than occupying the high upper-right position of the reference.
The scene lacks the reference's strong rocky, snow-covered foreground framing at both lower corners.

dimensions.reasons: The cabins, trees, cables, and pylons generally form a readable depth progression in alpine_gondola_goldenhour_4k, with smaller cabins and towers receding toward the lake. The large foreground pylon can plausibly be closer to the camera.
issues: The nearest cylindrical pylon is oversized and visually dominates the valley more than the support tower in the reference.
The simplified forest has a somewhat miniature, repeated-instancing appearance relative to the broad mountain terrain.
Cabin and tower engineering proportions are less convincing than the more complex real lift structure in the target.

dimensions.reasons: The final provides coherent cool-blue snow and ice against a softly warm golden-hour sky, with gentle illumination on the mountains and a clearly icy, faintly patterned lake. Metal pylons and red cabin panels have distinct enough surface treatments to read cleanly.
issues: Golden-hour effects are subdued: the long, directional shadows requested are limited, and much of the scene remains evenly cool-lit.
The lake surface has a repetitive rippled pattern rather than convincing subtle translucent/reflection behavior.
Snow, exposed rock, and foliage lack fine material breakup, so the layered natural surface treatment is less convincing.

dimensions.reasons: All main required categories are present in the author final and supporting Group A views: snow-capped mountains, a frozen lake, dense snow-covered conifers, exposed mountain rock, lift pylons, several cable lines, and red enclosed cabins. detail_lake_slope and detail_mid_lift also confirm that the lake and forest extend beyond the main camera composition.
issues: The visible cabin count is lower than the approximately five cabins in the reference.
A lattice-like lift tower matching the reference is absent; the scene uses simple pole-and-crossarm supports.
The characteristic rocky, snow-covered foreground cliffs of the source image are much less developed.

criteria.criterion: The delivered Blender project is openable, genuinely spatial, complete, and editable without prescribing non-planar geometry for every asset.
The background contains a varied ridge of multiple readable snow-capped peaks.
criteria.evidence: The author final image shows a broad layered horizon of individually readable, irregular snow-covered peaks, including prominent high summits at both far left and far right and many smaller intervening ridges with exposed rock.

criteria.criterion: A distinct frozen lake occupies the low valley basin and reads as a substantially level geographic feature.
criteria.evidence: A pale blue-gray, lightly patterned ice surface is clearly visible in the center-low distance of the final image, lying level within the basin between the rising forested and snowy mountain slopes.

criteria.criterion: The foreground and midground balance substantial snow-laden conifer swaths with exposed snowy slopes.
criteria.evidence: The final composition has substantial grouped conifer stands at both foreground sides and across the valley, with clearly layered white snow caps on their branch tiers; open rolling snow foreground and broad exposed mid-valley slopes remain visible around them.

criteria.criterion: Snow, ice, exposed rock, and vegetation form a correctly assigned and visually differentiated material system with the specified snow and ice responses.
The pylons, pylon heads, and parallel steel-like cables form one coherent reference-informed lift route crossing and receding through the frame.
Several red cabins form a genuinely instanced, reference-spaced, mechanically suspended sequence along the lift.
The landscape and lift preserve the reference's broad organization with believable cross-system proportions rather than becoming an unrelated invented scene.
The final scene replaces midday illumination with warm low-sun lighting and long cast shadows.
criteria.evidence: The final render uses a pale golden-yellow horizon and warm side illumination on the right-side trees and mountain faces, while elongated cool-blue tree shadows extend across the foreground snow, giving a low-sun golden-hour reading.

criteria.criterion: The actual final camera uses a medium-telephoto field of view and visibly produces the requested depth compression.
Exactly one intended final image is openable, genuinely high resolution, complete, and visually clean enough for instructional labels.

notes: This is a clean and recognizable stylized reconstruction with the principal alpine landscape and gondola-lift elements present. Its main shortcomings are reduced photographic fidelity and lift detail, an overdominant simple foreground pylon, fewer cabins, repetitive low-poly vegetation, and terrain slab boundaries exposed by the evaluator's wide views.
score_policy: Frozen paper score: uncapped 0.5 rubric + 0.5 dimension.
